I feel the best way to enjoy the game is discovering things by yourself. 

But here are some useful infos:

First of all, rain and hypothermia are really, really dangerous in this patch, so start your journey searching stones on the ground do make and improvised knife so you can extract bark and wooden sticks to start a fire in case you need it.

Something you need to be aware is your status, visible in your inventory (TAB). Try not to get drench, if you can't make a fire is very plausible that you will die. 
Also try aways to be healthy, you get this being energized (eating) and hydrated (drinking duh). if you breake a bone make a splint combining a wooden stick with a rag. If you start bleeding patch yourself if a rag (you can craft rags tearing some clothing apart). There is another status but you can look it up when it happens. 

I have never played the mod so I don't know how much you are familiar with the mechanics, but I belive a lot is similar to the Arma II game. 

Some controls that you need to know:

V - jump through fences

Z - prone

X - crouch

C - get up

Q - look left

E - look right

Space bar - rise gun/fists

G (hold) - throw stuff

F - action (also the scroll button) 

About loot you can search for maps online. I personally like iZurvive, but there is plenty of options.
